description_en: Queries metadata in a dataset by inputting natural language
description_zh: 通过输入自然语言，对数据集内的元数据进行基于语义的查询搜索
kebab_example: aliyun imm semantic-query --next-token Reserved._Not_supported_yet. --max-results 20 --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --query Scenery_of_Hangzhou_in_April_2021 --with-fields URI --media-types image --source-uri oss://test-bucket/test-object --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SemanticQuery

parameters.name: media_types

parameters.help_en:
Either this parameter or the Query parameter must be specified. This parameter is valid only for image searches on datasets configured with a search-by-image workflow.

URI of the source data for retrieval.
The URI must be in the oss\://${Bucket}/${Object} format. ${Bucket} specifies the name of the OSS bucket that is in the same region as the current project. ${Object} specifies the full path of the file that contains the file name extension.

Contact us if you need to configure a workflow template
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>该参数与 Query 参数必须有一个为非空值。该参数目前仅在指定搜索类型为图片且数据集配置了以图搜图相关工作流模板时有效。></notice>
用于检索的源数据的存储地址，存储地址支持 OSS 的 URI 地址。

OSS 地址规则为 oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中${Bucket}为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的 OSS Bucket 名称，${Object}为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径。

如您需要配置对应工作流模板，欢迎https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84454.html
